description: Read one rule34.xxx post, named by its id or by a link to its page. Returns every tag the post carries, each with its kind (character, copyright, artist, general or metadata) and how many posts share it, alongside the image or video, the dimensions, the score, the rating, the uploader, the number of comments, the credited source and the date the site took the post in. Use this after a search, whose rows show only the first few tags of each post.

id.description: The post's numeric id, as a search returns it.

url.description: A link to the post's page, such as https://rule34.xxx/index.php?page=post&s=view&id=2195419. The link is read rather than followed.

name: get_post

changed_at.description: When the post last changed, ISO 8601.

created_at.description: When the post was added to rule34.xxx, ISO 8601. The site imported much of its older catalogue in bulk, so thousands of posts share one day.

owner.description: The account that uploaded the post.

score.description: The site's own score, updated once a day.

post_count.description: Posts the site credits to this tag.

type.description: character, copyright, artist, general or metadata.

title: Read one post
